# Purpose

This file **does not change the pipeline**. It compares the parameter set written by
`00_genetic_parameters.Rmd` with the previous one (archived in
`archive_rg28/params/`, used for the earlier runs), so every change is visible
before files 01-05 are re-run. The previous version of this file (resilience QR vs MA and Saved
Feed as raw vs production-corrected DMI) is in the same archive folder.

Changes made:

1. Feeding rate (FR) is replaced by **Saved Feed (SF)**; DMI is dropped; ECM and body weight are
   not added as traits.
2. SF enters with its own published values: h^2^ = ReFI (Lidauer et al. 2023) and correlations =
   NAV Saved Feed index correlations (NAV 2026 note, Table 4), cow-weighted over breeds.
3. Population: CFIT installations (Lassen & Borchersen slides): 28,400 cows; 40 single-breed herds
   (largest-remainder rounding of 39 farms scaled to 40).

```{r load}
old_dir <- "archive_rg28/params"; new_dir <- "params"
h2_old <- fread(file.path(old_dir, "h2.csv")); h2_new <- fread(file.path(new_dir, "h2.csv"))
RG_old <- readRDS(file.path(old_dir, "RG_matrix.rds")); RG_new <- readRDS(file.path(new_dir, "RG_matrix.rds"))
src_old <- fread(file.path(old_dir, "rg_sourced.csv")); src_new <- fread(file.path(new_dir, "rg_sourced.csv"))
iw_old <- fread(file.path(old_dir, "index_weights.csv")); iw_new <- fread(file.path(new_dir, "index_weights.csv"))
sp_old <- fread(file.path(old_dir, "breed_country_split.csv")); sp_new <- fread(file.path(new_dir, "breed_country_split.csv"))
hd_old <- fread(file.path(old_dir, "herds.csv")); hd_new <- fread(file.path(new_dir, "herds.csv"))
```

# Trait set and heritabilities

```{r traits}
tr <- data.table(trait = union(h2_old$code, h2_new$code))
tr[, `:=`(before = trait %in% h2_old$code, now = trait %in% h2_new$code)]
kable(tr, caption = "Traits before and now")
hh <- merge(h2_old[, .(code, HOL_old = HOL, RDC_old = RDC, JER_old = JER)],
            h2_new[, .(code, HOL_new = HOL, RDC_new = RDC, JER_new = JER)], by = "code", all = TRUE)
kable(hh, caption = "Heritabilities before and now (NA = trait not in that set)")
```

# Population and herds

```{r population}
pop <- merge(sp_old[, .(cows_old = sum(n)), by = .(breed, country)],
             sp_new[, .(cows_new = sum(n), herds_new = sum(farms)), by = .(breed, country)], by = c("breed", "country"), all = TRUE)
kable(pop, caption = "Cows per breed x country before (ICAR 2026 abstract, equal split) and now (CFIT slides, equal-split rule)")
cat(sprintf("Cows: %d before, %d now. Herds: %d mixed-breed before, %d single-breed now.\n",
            sum(sp_old$n), sum(sp_new$n), nrow(hd_old), nrow(hd_new)))
```

# Sourced correlations: removed, added, kept

```{r pairs}
key <- function(d) d[, pair := paste(pmin(t1, t2), pmax(t1, t2), sep = "-")]
key(src_old); key(src_new)
removed <- src_old[!pair %in% src_new$pair, .(pair, rg, source)]
added   <- src_new[!pair %in% src_old$pair, .(pair, rg, source)]
changed <- merge(src_old[, .(pair, rg_old = rg)], src_new[, .(pair, rg_new = rg)], by = "pair")[rg_old != rg_new]
kable(removed, caption = "Removed (DMI and FR are no longer traits)")
kable(added, caption = "Added")
kable(changed, caption = "Kept but value changed (cow weights now CFIT 28,400)")
cat(sprintf("Sourced pairs: %d of %d before, %d of %d now.\n",
            nrow(src_old), choose(nrow(h2_old), 2), nrow(src_new), choose(nrow(h2_new), 2)))
```

# Saved Feed correlations: which NAV source?

Two NAV sets of Saved Feed index correlations exist for genomic bull calves: Stephansen et al.
(2025, Interbull Bull 61, Table 2; bulls born 2022) and the NAV note *Economic weight of Saved feed
in NTM* (2026, Table 4; bulls born 2022-2024). File 00 uses the NAV 2026 note (recent over old).
The table shows how much the choice matters, with the same CFIT cow weights and the same
sign reversals (Fertility and Udder health/Mastitis reversed into ICF and SCS).

```{r sf_sources}
n_breed <- sp_new[, .(n = sum(n)), by = breed][, setNames(n, breed)]
w <- function(h, r, j) sum(n_breed[c("HOL", "RDC", "JER")] * c(h, r, j)) / sum(n_breed)
# the NAV Yield index correlation is applied to both MY and PY
sf <- data.table(pair = c("MY-SF", "PY-SF", "ICF-SF", "SCS-SF", "LONG-SF"), sign = c(1, 1, -1, -1, 1),
  NAV2026_HOL = c(0.32, 0.32, -0.06, -0.11, -0.02), NAV2026_RDC = c(0.13, 0.13, 0.06, 0.00, 0.15), NAV2026_JER = c(0.35, 0.35, -0.17, -0.08, -0.08),
  Steph2025_HOL = c(0.26, 0.26, -0.02, -0.11, 0.01), Steph2025_RDC = c(0.07, 0.07, 0.12, 0.06, 0.17), Steph2025_JER = c(0.23, 0.23, -0.14, -0.11, -0.09))
sf[, `:=`(NAV2026 = sign * mapply(w, NAV2026_HOL, NAV2026_RDC, NAV2026_JER),
          Steph2025 = sign * mapply(w, Steph2025_HOL, Steph2025_RDC, Steph2025_JER))][, diff := NAV2026 - Steph2025]
kable(sf[, .(pair, NAV2026, Steph2025, diff)], digits = 3,
      caption = "Cow-weighted SF correlations from the two NAV sources (Stephansen 2025: udder trait = Mastitis)")
cat(sprintf("Largest difference between the two sources: %.3f\n", max(abs(sf$diff))))
```

# Matrix and implied values

```{r matrix}
ev <- eigen(RG_new, symmetric = TRUE, only.values = TRUE)$values
cat(sprintf("Smallest eigenvalue of the matrix used: %.4f\n", min(ev)))
ix <- which(upper.tri(RG_new), arr.ind = TRUE)
d <- data.table(t1 = rownames(RG_new)[ix[, 1]], t2 = colnames(RG_new)[ix[, 2]], rg = RG_new[ix])
key(d); d[, sourced := pair %in% src_new$pair]
kable(d[sourced == FALSE][order(-abs(rg))][abs(rg) >= 0.05], digits = 3,
      caption = "Unknown pairs: implied values |r| >= 0.05 (weighted bending, not estimates)")
both <- intersect(rownames(RG_old), rownames(RG_new))
dd <- data.table(t1 = both[row(diag(length(both)))], t2 = both[col(diag(length(both)))],
                 old = as.vector(RG_old[both, both]), new = as.vector(RG_new[both, both]))[t1 < t2][, change := new - old]
kable(dd[abs(change) >= 0.03][order(-abs(change))], digits = 3,
      caption = "Pairs present in both sets whose value moved by 0.03 or more (incl. implied values)")
```

# Index theory: what the change does to NTM selection

Response per unit selection intensity on true breeding values, (G w)~j~ / sqrt(w'Gw), for the NTM
index without NUE weight (GS_NTM) and with NUE weight 0.75. Before: Saved Feed = production-corrected
DMI; now: Saved Feed = SF. All traits in genetic SD.

```{r theory}
resp <- function(G, w) drop(G %*% w) / sqrt(drop(t(w) %*% G %*% w))
th <- function(G, iw, lab) rbindlist(lapply(c("HOL", "RDC", "JER"), function(b) rbindlist(lapply(intersect(c("GS_NTM", "GS_NTM_NUE75", "GS_NTM_NUE35_MUN", "GS_NTM_NUE35_CH4"), iw$index), function(s) {
  x <- iw[index == s & breed == b]; wv <- setNames(x$weight, x$trait)[rownames(G)]; wv[is.na(wv)] <- 0
  r <- resp(G, wv); data.table(set = lab, breed = b, index = s, trait = names(r), resp = r)
}))))
tt <- rbind(th(RG_old, iw_old, "before"), th(RG_new, iw_new, "now"))
kable(dcast(tt[trait %in% c("NUE", "MY", "PY", "CH4", "MUN", "SCS", "ICF", "LONG", "LNVAR", "SF", "DMI")],
            trait + index ~ set + breed, value.var = "resp"), digits = 3,
      caption = "Response per unit i (genetic SD), before vs now")
```

```{r save}
fwrite(tt, "params/update_check_index_theory.csv")
```
